newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tamadam Bonded proposes rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Tamadam Bonded proposes rights issue.

text.p: Tamadam Bonded Warehouse Bhd said on Thursday it is proposing a rights issue of 7.92 million new shares at 4.00 ringgit a share on a two-for-five basis.
In a statement, the bonded warehouse and transportation concern said the rights would be issued at an entitlement date to be announced later, pending various approvals.
Proceeds of about 31.68 million ringgit will be used to construct a new warehouse, repay bank debt and for the rights issue expenses, it said.
Following the issue, its share capital will rise to 27.72 million from 19.80 million at December 31, 1995.
